audience: freelancers and small teams who track projects, time and invoices in Paymo

useCases.title: Add up hours logged by your team
useCases.text: The AI lists time entries for a date range, user or project and adds up the durations. You see how many hours went into which project.

useCases.title: Find overdue tasks and who has them
useCases.text: The AI lists tasks by project, task list, assignee or completion and checks their due dates. It shows which tasks are late and who is assigned.

useCases.title: Check unpaid invoices by client
useCases.text: The AI lists invoices with status, due date and total and reads one with its line items and payments. It matches them to clients.

useCases.title: Log or edit time, or start and stop a timer
useCases.text: The AI logs a finished time entry on a task by date and duration or by start and end, or starts and stops a running timer. It can also edit an entry.

useCases.title: Create or update a task and add a comment
useCases.text: The AI creates a task in a task list or project, or renames, reassigns, re-dates or completes one. It can also comment on the task.

useCases.title: Set up a new project for a client
useCases.text: The AI creates a project for a client you pick from the client list.
